description: Set editorial preferences (Preferences > Notes, Track Changes, Story Editor Display and Type; View > Story Editor): note colour and tooltips, which changes show and how they are marked, Story Editor font, colours and cursor, the style name column and depth ruler, triple-click and smart cut and paste behaviour, and the user name

color.description: Note colour: a colour name such as "light_blue" or "grid_orange", or "#RRGGBB"

colorChoice.description: Colour notes with the note colour or each user's colour

spellCheck.description: Include note content when checking spelling

storyEditor.description: Story Editor Display preferences and View > Story Editor options

backgroundColor.description: Background colour: a colour name such as "light_blue" or "grid_orange", or "#RRGGBB"

textColor.description: Text colour: a colour name such as "light_blue" or "grid_orange", or "#RRGGBB"

changeBarColor.description: Change bar colour: a colour name such as "light_blue" or "grid_orange", or "#RRGGBB"

spellCheckDeletedText.description: Include deleted text when checking spelling

dragAndDropInLayout.description: Drag and drop text editing in layout view

dragAndDropInStoryEditor.description: Drag and drop text editing in Story Editor

singleClickConvertsFrames.description: Type Tool Converts Frames to Text Frames

smartCutAndPaste.description: Adjust Spacing Automatically When Cutting and Pasting Words

tripleClickSelectsLine.description: Triple Click to Select a Line (otherwise a paragraph)

userName.description: User name recorded with notes and tracked changes (File > User)
